locale.name: quiqqer.settings.cache.clear.description
locale.en:
Cache management

In QUIQQER and the QUIQQER extensions a lot of data is cached to increase the speed of the system. In normal operation of QUIQQER the cache does not need to be cleared manually. However, if changes are made to the system (settings, updates, template changes, database changes, etc.), it may be necessary to clear cached data.
